text:
maria: Heads-up  partner coordination thread for the upcoming SDK v3 breaking change (auth header rename + response envelope tweak). Need to finalize partner deadlines and a mitigation plan for SI installers and marketplace review delays.

sam: Proposed timeline:
- week 0: partner notice + migration FAQ
- week 2: publish SDK updates + migration scripts (py/js/go)
- week 4: invite 4 partners to private canary (mix of marketplace/SI/OEM)
- week 7: soft-deprecation (Deprecation header on v2)
- week 12: hard-deprecation (v2 returns 4xx)

jordan: can we include an explicit rollback playbook in the docs? some marketplace vendors want a clear path to revert if their listing fails review.

lee: legal note  I'll draft a 1-paragraph T&C addendum for Marketplace listings and an attestation for OEMs that bundle our runtime. also check if this triggers any change to support SLAs.

anya: ops  recommend a 72-hour dedicated support runway during the private canary and 48 hours after soft-deprecation. I'll coordinate oncall.

sam: migration snippet for docs:
```
# old
curl -H "Authorization: Token rw-old" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'
# new
curl -H "x-rw-api-key: rw-new" -H "x-rw-version: 3" https://api.redwood.ai/v3/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

maria: infra ask  we need perf deltas for top 3 models on primary GPU SKUs before canary. @sam can you run these with quantization variations?

sam: yes. will run by end of week 1 and post results.

deploy-bot: Note  Marketplace listings have a weekly blackout Sun 02:00-06:00 UTC; avoid that window for announcements and vendor uploads.

jordan: comms: I'll prepare two partner notice variants (marketplace vs SI/OEM) and include sample curl snippets, canary sign-up link, and expected timelines.

maria: we also need a small compatibility shim for partners who embed SDKs in installers. propose a 6-month compatibility shim that rewrites old headers at ingress; legal must sign off.

lee: ack. will prepare addendum and attestation.

maria: please drop a one-line owner update by Mon so I can finalize the calendar.
